checklist: F3 / SAFETY.md 6 (Mac layer only, was the export to a full disk): Save writes sidecars into the shoot folder, and the only disks a test can fill are images, which the app takes for removable media. So: the app's sidecar write refuses the image ('on the card'); the write below that check, on a disk with no space left, fails as 'disk full' (the page's word for the result list), with Lightroom's old sidecar untouched, no new sidecar and no temp file.
